clauses.quote: ~taff suggestions for policy modification shou~d be presented to the Superintendent.
clauses.notes: OCR artifacts in original ('~taff', 'shou~d'); imposes duty on staff to submit policy suggestions to Superintendent.

clauses.quote: They shall be consistent with policies adopted by the Board.
clauses.notes: 'They' refers to administrative regulations; imposes consistency requirement on district rules.

clauses.quote: The Board shall be provided with copies of said rules and regulations.
clauses.notes: Grants the Board the right/entitlement to receive copies of administrative regulations.

clauses.quote: The Superintendent or the Superintendent's designee is authorized to close schools in the event of hazardous weather or other emergencies which present threats to the safety of students, school staff, or school property.
clauses.subject_text: The Superintendent or the Superintendent's designee
clauses.notes: Grants discretionary authority to close schools for safety emergencies.

clauses.quote: Any changes in the guidelines must be ratified by the Board.
clauses.notes: Imposes a mandatory ratification duty on the Board for any modifications to site-based management guidelines.
